description: MUST-FAIL: representation mismatch. The artifact type registry declares representation as 64-char lowercase hex, but the typed reference carries a sha256:-prefixed string. These are not the same representation and MUST NOT be treated as equivalent.
spec_ref: draft-mih-sokolov-scitt-payload-binding-00 §4.1 ('Representation is normative and must be declared by the payload class. The following representations are distinct and not interchangeable: Bare 64-character lowercase hex string; Prefixed text string (e.g., sha256:...); Raw 32-byte octet sequence.')

erroneous_verification.mistake: Verifier strips 'sha256:' prefix and compares the remainder to the recomputed bare hex. Treating the prefixed form as the bare form.
erroneous_verification.why_wrong: The registry declares bare 64-char lowercase hex. The carried value 'sha256:0c837d01...' is a different representation. The verifier MUST NOT strip the prefix; it MUST report that the identifier carried by the reference is inconsistent with the established context.

correct_handling.step_1: Resolve type 'authorization-doc' from registry: representation is bare 64-char lowercase hex
correct_handling.step_2: Typed reference carries 'sha256:0c837d01...' which is not bare hex — it is prefixed
correct_handling.step_3: Verifier MUST detect that the carried identifier is inconsistent with the established context
correct_handling.step_4: Verifier MUST NOT report this typed reference as verified
